items.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021
items.q: I was looking up and I was walking with the baritone player, Pat Patrick.

ctx.x: Indeed. And now we have UFOs that seem to be circling around. I wonder what Sun Ra would have thought of that?

Well when we was riding in Oklahoma on tour, and one of those UFOs was following us. And in Oklahoma you could see, you know, it was beautiful out there anyway. But it was following us and it followed us about five, ten minutes. And I was at the World’s Fair in New York, the World’s Fair they had there, and I’ve seen six of them. And I was looking up and I was walking with the baritone player, Pat Patrick. And we’re standing there looking up at this and they was just making a show, and then they said [scats] and…
Very interesting. Did Sun Ra include things in his written music other than actual notes? Like —
